events.summary: Doctor Doom claims the Power Cosmic.
events.quote: Now, it is I who possess the Power Cosmic!

events.summary: Franklin Richards creates a baby universe alone in his room.
events.quote: All alone in his room, a boy created a baby universe.

events.summary: Cosmic rays tear through the Fantastic Four's ship, beginning their story.
events.quote: We ignored the risks and the cosmic rays tore through our ship.

events.summary: After the Skrull invasion of Earth is thwarted, Skrulls choose a peaceful life.
events.quote: After the Skrull invasion of Earth was thwarted, they volunteered to do no more harm in exchange for a peaceful life.

events.summary: Frankie Raye declares herself transformed and free.
events.quote: I'm still Frankie Raye. Just a newer, better Frankie Raye. And I'm free!

events.summary: Doom reminds Reed that he saved Reed's wife and daughter when Reed could not.
events.quote: remember every time you look at your wife and daughter that Doom saved them both . . . when you could not.

events.summary: The Black Knight leaves the Supreme Intelligence defenseless.
events.quote: The Supreme Intelligence is defenseless now.

events.summary: Loki springs a trap on Thor, turning him into a frog.
events.quote: The trap is sprung, and Loki has achieved his most brilliant jest!

events.summary: T'Challa merges vibranium technology with organic matter to create a jungle.
events.quote: T'Challa merged vibranium technology with organic matter to create a jungle of boundless potential.

events.summary: T'Challa summons the legions of past Panthers, who rally to him.
events.quote: T'Challa summoned the legions of Panthers past, and the dead rallied to their now and forever king.

events.summary: Doom completes another instrument of global domination.
events.quote: It was not the first time Doom had cackled triumphantly upon completing an instrument of global domination.

events.summary: The Sentry's memory returns, revealing his Watchtower.
events.quote: The Sentry's Watchtower lay just beyond sight for decades, until his memory returned.

events.summary: The Fantastic Four is born.
events.quote: And so was born the Fantastic Four!

events.summary: Reed Richards, on trial for sparing Galactus, finds a cosmic truth and an ally.
events.quote: On trial for sparing Galactus, Reed Richards found a cosmic truth and an unexpected ally.

events.summary: Bast welcomes T'Challa to the City of the Dead.
events.quote: Welcome, T'Challa, to the City of the Dead.

events.summary: The Fantastic Four reach Attilan after a perilous journey.
events.quote: After a perilous journey, the Fantastic Four beheld Attilan, the Great Refuge of the Inhumans.

events.summary: After overloading the grid thirteen times, Reed builds the Baxter Building its own power supply.
events.quote: he built the Baxter Building its own power supply.

events.summary: Bashenga forges a blade from the fallen rock to protect the land.
events.quote: From the great rock that fell from the sky, Bashenga, the first king, forged a blade to protect the land.

events.summary: Fin Fang Foom awakens after countless centuries.
events.quote: After countless centuries, I live again!

events.summary: Thor journeys to Jotunheim to battle the Frost Giants.
events.quote: Odin's son journeyed to the icy realm of Jotunheim, seeking to test his raging thunder against the Frost Giant horde.

events.summary: Odin strips Thor of his title and of Mjölnir.
events.quote: No longer art thou God of Thunder! Nor shall Mjölnir serve thee now!

events.summary: Rick Jones becomes joined with Mar-Vell.
events.quote: Mar-Vell is part of me now. Like I am of him.

events.summary: A Skrull invasion is turned back to Skrullos.
events.quote: There will be no invasion today.

events.summary: Mendel Stromm engineers his revenge.
events.quote: Mendel Stromm didn't just seek revenge. He engineered it.
